message: Thanks. A few quick questions: Which state do you live in? Are you 65 or older? Do you have a disability? How much Social Security do you get per year? Any other income a year (pensions, unemployment, interest, child support)? Roughly how much is in bank accounts and investments?
reply: We're in Pennsylvania. My dad lives with us, he's 72. No. About 30 thousand a year. I'd have to check. Somewhere between 140 thousand and 200 thousand.

message: Thanks. How many people live in your household in total (including you and your dad)? How many children under 18 live with you? And do you have any other income a year (pensions, unemployment, interest, child support)?
reply: Just me. No kids. I'd have to check.

summary: PA, no earned income, no kids, father (72) with ~$30k Social Security lives in home, assets $140-200k. Household size unclear (said "just me" but dad lives there). Medicaid likely via PA expansion if applicant is under 65 with ~zero own income; SNAP/SSI likely blocked by assets; other income unknown. Caseworker should clarify household composition and income.
